meta.title: Hoard — Your personal content library
meta.description: Revisit your Douyin and Bilibili favorites in one desktop library. Multiple accounts, search, filters, a timeline, video playback and galleries, with data stored locally.

hero.eyebrow: FOR EVERYTHING YOU SAVED FOR LATER
hero.description: Bring your likes and favorites together. Search, browse and rediscover the things worth revisiting.
hero.note: Open source · Local first · macOS / Windows / Linux
hero.caption: Keep what you love within reach.

sources.title: Your favorites, together at last.

features.title: Your library

features.timelineBody: Browse by publication date and jump to the month you have in mind.

features.localTitle: Your library stays on your device.
features.localBody: Your collection index and login sessions stay on your device, ready when you return.
features.collectionLabel: Your collections come together in Hoard

download.eyebrow: A NEW HOME FOR YOUR FAVORITES
download.title: Download Hoard
download.description: MIT licensed. Contributions and feedback are welcome.

items.a: Yes. Hoard is open source under the MIT license. Use it, explore the code, report an issue or contribute.

items.q: Where are my accounts and data stored?
items.a: Account sessions, collection indexes and caches are stored on your device. No extra Hoard account is needed.

items.q: How do I get started and update?
items.a: Choose a download for your system, install it and connect a platform account. Your collection syncs automatically. Get future updates in the app settings.

footer.tagline: Keep what you love within reach.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: This notice covers the Hoard desktop application and this website.

sections.title: Data stored by the desktop app
sections.body: Hoard stores account information, synced content and covers on your device. Login sessions are stored separately for each account.

sections.title: Explore
sections.body: Explore runs on your device and does not upload your collection.

sections.title: Network requests
sections.body: Login, sync and playback connect to the corresponding content platforms. Update checks and downloads connect to GitHub or acceleration services offered by the app. These services process requests and network information under their own policies.

sections.title: This website
sections.body: This website has no analytics, advertising or account system. The host and sites such as GitHub may log requests under their own policies.

sections.title: Removal and cleanup
sections.body: Signing out removes that account's local data.

sections.title: Questions
sections.body: Contact the maintainers through GitHub Issues. Remove account details, cookies, tokens and other sensitive information before submitting a report.
